common_value_oracle: Each positive has one original two-u8 lexical T, one loop, one syntactic Continue and one syntactic Break, and one scoped replace in the Continue arm.
At each reachable Continue phase the pure inner IF evaluates only its selected arm. Its u8 result passes through ordinary binding/Copy; both operands are dependency-free typed literals.

old/old_copy equal the selected field immediately before replacement; they remain u8 copies of that old package after the original field changes. Copy aliases are value copies, not borrowed aliases to original storage.
current is the selected incoming value; known-disjoint sibling remains its initial value; original is the same live root with that selected field changed. No reconstructed T substitutes for original.
continue transfers next phase and old_copy to fresh iteration bindings. Break returns the actual current memory carry, including the initial seed when there are zero Continues.
P04 deliberately ends with current=86 and Break=52. L01 and P03 both return 78, but their traces differ, so function result alone cannot validate selection or old/current correctness.
Every positive phase and addition is at most 10 and representable on ordinary supported usize targets; all u8 literals are 0..255.
Native returned bits/address equality are observations, not proofs of ghost ValueFact freshness, provenance, scope authority, or sound cyclic header joins.

address_and_identity_oracle.root: For a later C-approved read-only observer, identify storage of the source-created original T, not a trace reconstruction. Compare its address at every point to B0: equality required while live.
address_and_identity_oracle.children: Identify the actual two declared child subobjects of that same original. Each child's address must stay equal to its own B0 address; child0 and child1 occupy distinct disjoint u8 subobjects. Compare writer destination with exactly the selected child's address; never infer selection merely from equal numeric bits.
address_and_identity_oracle.layout_boundary: Do not require root address to differ from first-child address: offset-zero equality is possible. Do not prescribe ABI offsets, struct padding, unrelated old_copy local addresses, or numeric address constants.
address_and_identity_oracle.ghost: Original root/child PlaceId and incarnation relationships remain those of original. Selected child and ancestor current facts follow each actual replace; the known-disjoint sibling fact remains valid. Same-bits replacements do not license reuse of stale selected/root fact evidence. A future genuine source-issued owned inspection must establish these separately; native bits/addresses cannot.
